strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: verifie keybox aktyel kont lalis revokasion Google (CRL) e sey plizier sours ziska ki li trouv enn keybox valid, avek enn backup otomatik ek enn relansman bann servis Google. Li fonksionn lor sak tap e bizin internet (1-3 minit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox depi rezo: telesarz enn keybox depi repozitwar ofisiel (GitHub) ek anrezistre li dan /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Bizin internet ek pran 1-3 minit. Servi kan smart fetch-la pa marse ou kan keybox-la finn sanze manyelman.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnostik: verifie bann modil Remote Key Provisioning ki disponib, inspekte version sertifika atestasion TEE, ek montre leta zouti KmInstallKeybox. Pa sanz nanye — enn vi stati laparey sinp.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): montre bann indikater nivo Widevine (L1/L3) depi dumpsys, prezans DRM (IDM) key-file, ek bann propriete sistem ki relie. Pa modifie nanie ditou.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manyel RKP fix: fer marse sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh maniel. Regle bann problem atestasion kan pas otomatik-la fel. Sak lekours inprim enn laliyn sikse/esek kler.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Fix RKP konple: roul sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh konple. Li okip bann ka difisil e li pran plis letan. Enn rezilta kler aparet alafin.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: efas bann done servis Play Store ek Google (GMS+GSF) ek relans laparey-la otomatikman. Zis pou bann atestasion teti — zame li tous ou bann foto ouswa ou bann fisie.
strings.mdCertify: • Sertifikasyon zwe: verifie leta atestasion sertifika RKP laparey-la ek reset bann propriete atestasion si neseser. Pa tous bann done itilizater.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER reparasion: regle bann problem Google services framework (SOTER) ki ena enn lien avek atestasion laparey. Servi pou sertin laparey ki depann lor SOTER olie Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Aplik PIF: fer marse sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh lafors. Aplik lanprint ki finn swazir (lokal/avanse) ek met azour bann fisie pif.prop/pif.json. Enn rezilta kler pou aparet dan rezis-la.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: montre leta moter ki finn instale, bann fisie lanprint (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ek bann rezis. Zis verifie — li ​​pa modifie nanie.
strings.mdCanary: • Miz-a-zour Canary: fer sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m marse. Get dernie version Canary Engine pou asir konpatibilite avek bann sertifika obligatwar RKP (Fevriye 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Diagnostik moter: verifie leta TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), bann fisie keybox (aktif vs itilizater), lanprint laparey reel vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP bann lakle. Afis diagnostik selman.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Bann plas dan bwat lakle (primer / segonder)
strings.hintKbSlots: Modil-la zer de plas dan bwat lakle: primer (sakre, zame finn efase) ek segonder (backup). Sa tab-la montre ki slot aktiv, sanz preferans, ouswa promouvwar segonder a primer lor enn demann explisit — avek bann backup ek enn rezis konple.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Diagnostik lentegrite: verifie inportasion lakle TEE, inzeksion bibliotek andan keystore2, stati revokasion (CRL), kouvertir lalis proteksion ek leta RKP. Zis pou lir — li ​​pa sanz nanye.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Lalis proteksion finn rekonstrir apartir sak aplikasion ki finn instale.
• Kous konpatibilite custom-ROM finn re-aplike.
• Keybox aktif finn re-aplike.
#000#servis re-demarre.

Nanye pa finn efase ek bwat-kle prinsipal zame pa finn touse.

Kontinie?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Bann fant keybox: montre leta bann slot primer ek segonder e sanz preferans ant zot. Primer-la (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) touletan proteze e zame finn efase. Pou promouvwar segonder a primer bizin enn konfirmasion explisit.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Efas fant segonder:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml pou retire.
• Fant primer pa finn touse.

Kontinie?

Re-demar Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — re-demar selman.
• Nanye pa finn efase e ou PA pou dekonekte.
• Laparey-la re-demar otomatikman.
000#Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Fors re-provizionnman (Mazik Rouz):

• Pou bann laparey ki inyor bwat lakle ki finn fwit.

• Pena okenn done ki finn efase.

Kontinie?
